integrity: The proof normalizes every published facet inequality in the Euclidean metric, obtains a sharp upper bound from a longest chain, constructs a matching uniform center, derives the complete incenter set from facet clearances, and proves the uniqueness criterion by longest-chain saturation and an explicit perturbation when coverage fails. Finite poset enumeration is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the standard Euclidean realization of the ordinary chain polytope of a finite nonempty poset. It does not determine circumradii, extremal ellipsoids, or the corresponding metric invariants for arbitrary marked or intermediate chain-order polytopes. A broader packing-polytope Chebyshev theorem under different terminology remains a residual originality risk.
title: The Euclidean inradius of a chain polytope depends only on poset height
